# Country scope. Bitmask of currently held vanilla hegemons (0..31) for W4 telemetry ([OE_BAL_SNAP] heg=):
# +1 military_hegemon, +2 naval_hegemon, +4 economic_hegemon, +8 cultural_hegemon, +16 diplomatic_hegemon.
oe_heg2_held_mask = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { is_hegemon_type = hegemony:military_hegemon } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { is_hegemon_type = hegemony:naval_hegemon } add = 2 }
	if = { limit = { is_hegemon_type = hegemony:economic_hegemon } add = 4 }
	if = { limit = { is_hegemon_type = hegemony:cultural_hegemon } add = 8 }
	if = { limit = { is_hegemon_type = hegemony:diplomatic_hegemon } add = 16 }
}

# Country scope. Ordering weight for selecting global_var:oe_heg2_polar_leader among Great Powers.
oe_heg2_polar_weight = {
	value = oe_heg2_held_count
	multiply = 1000
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_sim_multi_heg }
		add = 4000
	}
	add = great_power_score
}

# Country scope. Ordering weight for selecting global_var:oe_heg2_polar_rival opposing scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader.
oe_heg2_rival_weight = {
	value = great_power_score
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader
			is_rival_of = scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader
		}
		add = 200
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader
			is_neighbor_of = scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader
		}
		add = 100
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader
			is_at_war_with = scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader
		}
		add = 150
	}
}
